trackedCompetitors.name: Click Currency
trackedCompetitors.positioning: Right-click browser extension for quick currency conversion on SaaS, ecommerce, finance, and travel pages.
trackedCompetitors.pricingModel: Free tier plus pay-what-you-want lifetime premium.

evidence.website: 3 free currency pairs; premium unlocks unlimited pairs and real-time rates.
evidence.storeSignal: Chrome Web Store search snippet showed 2.0 rating with 21 ratings.

whatToCopy: Premium fence around unlimited pairs and real-time rates
whatToAvoid: Shipping a premium wall before trust and reviews exist

trackedCompetitors.name: BestPrice Assistant
trackedCompetitors.positioning: Broader shopping assistant that still includes automatic in-page currency conversion.

evidence.features: Whitelist/blacklist, fee or tax percentage, popup quick converter, ambiguous currency handling.

whatToCopy: Fee or tax adjustment as a traveler/shopper aid

trackedCompetitors.name: Universal Automatic Currency Converter
trackedCompetitors.positioning: Highly customizable automatic currency conversion with popup mini-converter and whitelist controls.
trackedCompetitors.monetizationModel: Free utility with optional service endpoint.

evidence.marketplace: Firefox Add-ons showed 712 users and 74 reviews.
evidence.reviewThemes: Customization praised; confusing setup, nonsense values, CPU/memory overload, and spreadsheet false positives criticized.

trackedCompetitors.name: CurrencyOS
trackedCompetitors.positioning: Privacy-forward Chrome extension with onboarding, context menu, popup, and omnibox conversion.
trackedCompetitors.pricingModel: Free extension marketing page surfaced; no paid tier clearly exposed.

evidence.website: Claims no servers, no data collection, hourly rate sync, context-menu conversion, popup conversion, and inline Chrome search-bar conversion.

whatToAvoid: Adding too many modes before revenue exists

trackedCompetitors.name: Currency.Wiki browser extension
trackedCompetitors.positioning: Cross-platform extension within a wider currency ecosystem including apps, widgets, alerts, and Shopify.
trackedCompetitors.pricingModel: Free forever extension with account and ecosystem upsell.

evidence.website: Publicly claims 4.7 rating, 50k+ users, and sign-in for price alerts.

weaknesses: Less tightly focused on inline conversion
whatToAvoid: Building an ecosystem before the first customer exists

trackedCompetitors.name: QuickCConverter
trackedCompetitors.positioning: Popup-first quick converter with on-page selection, offline support, and auto-save behavior.

evidence.store: Chrome Web Store showed 9,000 users and 116 ratings.
evidence.features: Offline support, 100+ currencies, auto-save, multi-currency live converter.

whatToCopy: Multi-currency compare as later premium feature

trackedCompetitors.name: Savely
trackedCompetitors.positioning: Price-comparison browser extension that automatically finds cheaper offers on product pages.

evidence.website: Featured by Google, Verified by Google, 1B+ products, 20k retailers, 40+ countries.

whatToCopy: Trust badges and strong proof language
whatToAvoid: Trying to match data scale before revenue

trackedCompetitors.name: Wise referral and influencer programs
trackedCompetitors.positioning: Cross-border money product with consumer referrals and creator CPA economics.

evidence.official: Public referral page plus influencer help page showing creator incentive structures including £10 qualifying referral fees.

whatToCopy: Use website content as the monetization surface for affiliate offers
whatToAvoid: Stuffing affiliate CTAs into the extension runtime

trackedCompetitors.name: Travelpayouts
trackedCompetitors.positioning: Travel affiliate platform for creators and brands.

evidence.official: Publicly claims 650,000 creators and 90+ trusted travel brands.

strengths: Strong proof that travel intent monetizes
whatToAvoid: Trying to monetize travel before traffic exists

trackedCompetitors.name: XE Currency Data API
trackedCompetitors.positioning: Business-grade currency data API for companies and enterprise systems.

evidence.official: Lite package shown at $799/year with 10,000 requests/month and daily rates.

weaknesses: Massive reliability and sales gap vs FX Inline
whatToCopy: Business-value framing for future B2B packaging
whatToAvoid: Trying to compete as a raw FX data provider right now

trackedCompetitors.name: FX Auto Convert
trackedCompetitors.positioning: New entrant offering tooltip, inline, or replace display modes with all-website access.

evidence.chrome_stats: Created 2026-02-16, version 0.1.1, 6 users, all_urls host access.

strengths: Fresh entrant with multiple display modes
weaknesses: Low trust due youth and all-site permissions
whatToAvoid: Assuming tiny low-trust entrants are strong monetization evidence

trackedCompetitors.name: Currency Converter Injector
trackedCompetitors.positioning: Firefox add-on that injects converted values beside prices on any website.

evidence.marketplace: Firefox Add-ons showed 4.3 rating and 15 users.
evidence.review: One review explicitly called out exposed API keys.

whatToAvoid: Any sloppy API-key or trust mistake

trackedCompetitors.name: InMyTwoCents CurrencyConverter
trackedCompetitors.positioning: Recent Firefox inline-conversion add-on with favorites and regex customization.

evidence.marketplace: Recent Firefox entry with no reviews and no obvious traction.

whatToAvoid: Treating every new entrant as evidence of a good business

trackedCompetitors.name: In-line Currency Converter
trackedCompetitors.positioning: Recent Firefox auto-convert add-on with right-click menu and highlight behavior.

evidence.marketplace: Firefox Add-ons showed 4.0 rating with 6 reviews and 29 users.

strengths: Recent entrant with some review traction
whatToAvoid: Mistaking a fragmented long tail for an open premium market
